cards.name: Juxtapose
cards.text: You and target player exchange control of the creature you each control with the greatest mana value. Then exchange control of artifacts the same way. If two or more permanents a player controls are tied for greatest, their controller chooses one of them.

cards.name: Mercenaries
cards.text: {3}: The next time this creature would deal damage to you this turn, prevent that damage. Any player may activate this ability.
